dedupe_keys.name: instituto canario de estadistica istac port and maritime datasets

description: Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC): port and maritime datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC). Coverage: Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC). The listing groups 17 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about port and maritime; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Tráfico de pasajeros en los Puertos del Estado de las islas de Canaria; Tráfico de vehículos en los Puertos Canarios de las islas de Canarias ; Tráfico de embarcaciones de recreo en los puertos deportivos de Puerto; Tráfico de pasajeros en los Puertos Canarios de las islas de Canarias . Formats seen: JSON, XML, SHEET, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.gobiernodecanarias.org/istac/aviso_legal.html). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
